entry.focal: A long one-point perspective of niche lanterns doubled in the water, leading to the elbow. The hero thread is not distinguishable at the elbow.
entry.next_visible: The lantern line leads on to the elbow.

reveal.focal: Near niche lanterns (bottom-left and right). The hero wall_trickle is a dim brown vertical slab at the elbow with the basin as a dark box: unlit, darker than the niches.
reveal.next_visible: The niches running west beyond the elbow.

concept.focal: Vanishing-point lantern lines (right side evenly spaced). No teal slot glow on the left, no warm steam light at the far end, which is black.
concept.next_visible: No: the far end (grotto) is dark at 50 m.

strip.focal: Good lantern rhythm on the diagonal (0–2). It thins to near-black on the long straight (4–6). The grotto hall appears only at frame 7.

fixes.detail: Give the thread its own narrow warm downlight plus an emissive water thread from a ceiling slot (as light_notes intends), so it is the brightest thing for the whole 30 m approach. Today it is unlit.

The knee-high slot window is not visible at all: no teal leaks onto the water halfway. Make the glazing emissive teal (or a teal area light on the water at 112,114), so the long straight gets its second beat.
Groups are not honoured on the north side: 5 niches at an even ~4.1 m (135.5…117.5), versus 3 on the south side. Regenerate with groups {n:2, inner:1.4, gap:[6,8]} on both sides.

Placed at z -10.5 (9.5 m above the floor, inside the rock) while the intent says z -17.6. Lower it by 7.1 m, and give it a warm backlight so the far west end of the straight glows ('steam glow from the grotto at the far end').

53 boulder_rim in two continuous kerb rows at 2.2–4 m spacing, tops within ±10 cm of the water (flat tiles). Cluster them in 4–6 groups at the elbow, the slot and the bonsai, with tops 0.1–0.25 m proud, and leave long plain stretches.

top_change: Light the three beats this corridor is built on (a bright thread at the elbow, the teal slot halfway, a warm glow at the grotto end), so the 50 m straight has goals instead of a fading line of identical niches.
plausibility: grotto_glow_noren at z -10.5 floats ~6 m above the 3 m corridor ceiling (intent z -17.6).
Rim boulders flush with or under the water line.
The mirror_slot needs cutting through both the corridor and the dome shells (intent note). From the corridor it currently shows nothing, so check that the cut exists.
